head: $215 BILLION
*GONE IN 24 HOURS*
scenes.say: Two hundred fifteen billion dollars, gone from crypto in one day. The whole market is down almost eight percent.

head: WHY?
*TECH STOCKS* *SOLD OFF*
scenes.say: Why? Analysts point to a selloff in US tech stocks. Investors dumped risky bets.

head: $1.3 BILLION
*LIQUIDATED*
scenes.say: Leverage made it worse. Reportedly over one point two billion dollars in bets were liquidated.

head: XRP -10%
*WORST OF THE* *TOP FIVE*
scenes.say: The biggest move: X R P, down ten percent. Ether minus eight, Bitcoin six.

head: $73K OR $80K?
*THE LINES TO WATCH*
scenes.say: Watch seventy three thousand and eighty thousand. Two hundred fifteen billion in a day. Not financial advice, just data.
